column1: # Unpacking on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Unity 2019.4.34f1 IL2CPP with Wwise on SDK 13.3.2, update 2.01, 3,948 shaders from Data/*.assets and Data/Resources, all translated. It plays by touch, as on the Switch in
# handheld mode: tap to take an item out of a box, drag it into place; menus and the name entry (the overlay keyboard) by touch too. On Android the screen is a touch screen
# docked as well (hle_hid.c), where Unity 2019.4 takes the panel's values as screen pixels (DM_TOUCH_DOCKED=screen, hle_touch.c). The on-screen gamepad is off by default
# (it covers the room; the pause menu turns it on) and a controller works as on the Switch.
# On the Y700 (2026-10-26): the Humble Games logo movie, the title, settings, credits, a new game, the name entry and the first room (1997), by touch, docked (1920x1080) and
# handheld (1280x720). 60 fps held, as the game asks (present interval 1): frame work p50 6-7 ms in the room, no audio underrun; screen recordings found no flickering frame,
# standing or dragging items; a 10-minute touch soak docked, no red log line. A play session by hand on the same build: music and effects clean (no crackle or dropout), the
# save kept across launches, and the notes screen (the album, the button at the top left of a room), which froze until the host had a standard shared font (Android's Roboto).
# The base game 1.0 alone (v0, a derived profile, 2026-10-31; GitHub issue #26): its sdk is SDK 11.4.3's 2d369d99, which now has 2.01's node-area and alignment cuts (sdk_patches.py).
# The title, a new album, the first room (1997) and items out of a box at 60 fps, no refusal. Without the cuts its StandardAllocator region ended at +4.14 GB of the alias region; with them +3.21 GB.
